outcome: Postoperative pain scores at rest and on movement
cohort: 150 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Intraperitoneal instillation of bupivacaine and lidocaine reduced early pain scores on movement compared to placebo, but there were no significant differences in pain scores at rest, total fentanyl consumption, or time to first analgesic request between the three groups.
